item.title: 🟠 CVE-2024-49123 Windows Remote Desktop Services Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.
To comprehensively address this vulnerability Windows 11 Version 26H1 for ARM64-based Systems and Windows 11 Version 26H1 for64-based Systems have been added to the Security Updates table. Microsoft recommend updating to the June 2026 version of your Windows operating systems.

Source: Microsoft Security Response Center  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 6h ago

item.title: 🔴 Chrome V8 Zero-Day CVE-2026-11645 Exploited in the Wild - Patch Now
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
Google has released security updates to address 74 vulnerabilities, including one that has come under active exploitation in the wild. The high-severity vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-11645 (CVSS score: 8.8), has been described as an out-of-bounds memory access in V8, Chrome's JavaScript and WebAssembly engine. Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 8h ago

item.title: 🔴 CISA gives feds 3 days to patch Check Point VPN bug exploited as zero-day
item.description:
Why this matters: Elevated ransomware risk — validate backups and endpoint defenses.
CISA has ordered U.S. government agencies to secure their Check Point Remote Access VPN and Mobile Access deployments against a critical vulnerability exploited in zero-day attacks by Qilin ransomware affiliates. [...]
